units.source_text: 柏木并不回到落叶公主房中，却悄悄地走进父亲前太政大臣邸内。

en.t: Kashiwagi did not return to Princess Ochiba's rooms, but quietly slipped into the residence of his father, the former Grand Minister.

units.source_text: 他躺下身子，但不能合眼，心中寻思昨夜所做的那个梦，不知是否真有应验。

en.t: He lay down, but could not close his eyes, wondering whether the dream he had had the night before might truly come to pass.

units.source_text: 但觉梦中那只猫非常可爱。

en.t: All he could feel was that the cat in the dream had been very lovely.

units.source_text: 他想：“我犯下弥天大罪了！

en.t: He thought, "I have committed a terrible, heaven-defying sin!

units.source_text: 今后在世间有何面目见人呢？”

en.t: How can I ever show my face before anyone in the world from now on?"

units.source_text: 他又是恐怖，又是羞耻，不敢出门。

en.t: He was both terrified and ashamed, and did not dare go out.

units.source_text: 此事使三公主伤心，自不必说；柏木自己心中，也觉得十分荒唐。

en.t: Needless to say, this affair grieved the Third Princess; Kashiwagi himself also felt, in his heart, that it was utterly absurd.

units.source_text: 想起了对方是源氏，尤其觉得可怕，竟是无法抵赖的了。

en.t: When he remembered that the other party was Genji, he felt all the more afraid, for there was no way to deny what had happened.

units.source_text: 假定所触犯的是皇帝的妻子，而事情被发觉了，但因自知罪孽深重，即使身受极刑，亦可死而无憾。

en.t: If the woman he had violated had been the emperor's wife and the matter had come to light, then, knowing the depth of his guilt, he could have suffered the severest punishment and died without regret.

units.source_text: 如今虽然不致身犯死罪，但被源氏所仇视，实在非常可怕，又非常可耻。

en.t: Now, although his offense would not bring the death penalty, to be hated by Genji was truly terrifying and deeply shameful.
